feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: iteration 9 (y=0.045, ±0.055, base_speed 1.4) scored 67.70, the best so far. It had 0.9 line losses on s-bend and 1.0 on slalom, with oval progress of 0.242. Iteration 8 (same geometry at base_speed 1.6) had 0.95 and 1.0 losses, so cutting speed did not clear the losses. Iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) had zero losses but only 0.040 s-bend progress, and iterations 6 to 9 showed that forward rows at y=0.045 to 0.06 always lost the line about once per trial. Iterations 0 to 9 show the max_error floor at about 0.060 to 0.063 under every span, track, radius, mass, lookahead and ki change, so I do not expect geometry to move it. The Integrator kept the iteration 9 controller unchanged. This is the final iteration, so no later Builder iteration will use these changes. The requested changes below are for reference only.
requested_changes: If line losses stay near 1 per trial on s-bend and slalom with this row, the forward row itself is the cause. The next test would be y=0.03 with ±0.055, because iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) had zero losses while y=0.045 to 0.06 always lost the line.

If progress on s-bend stays near 0.14 but losses persist, keep y=0.045 and try sensor_size 0.012 to test whether a smaller footprint reduces edge losses, since the 16 mm footprint has not been compared at this row.
If oval progress is high but max_error stays at about 0.061, do not chase the floor with span, track, radius or mass, because iterations 0 to 9 show none of these moved it.
